scenario: A saturation estimator is evaluated against interpreted time-lapse seismic observations from one storage project.
reason: The ML output is directly compared with field evidence from one case.

scenario: A surrogate is trained on simulations built from a named field model but is tested only on simulator output.
coding_outcome: field_derived_inputs_only or field_inspired_simulation_only; not field validated
reason: The field setting informs the simulation, but no ML output is evaluated against observations.

scenario: A model is tested on measurements from a planned injection experiment, but the paper does not establish whether the workflow supported an operating-site decision.
coding_outcome: controlled_field_evaluation pending locator-based recheck; score 2 or 3 remains unresolved
reason: A controlled experiment is empirical, but it is not automatically an operating storage-site workflow.

scenario: A plume surrogate reports mass-balance residuals and plume-volume error over forecast time.
coding_outcome: diagnostic_checked; physical consistency score at least 3
reason: A decision-relevant physical diagnostic is quantitatively evaluated.

scenario: A neural operator learns simulator outputs, but the paper reports only pixel-wise prediction error.
coding_outcome: inherited_or_discussed; physical consistency score no higher than 1 on this evidence
reason: Simulator provenance does not itself verify physical consistency of the learned output.

scenario: A PINN includes a conservation residual in the loss but does not report the residual or an independent balance check on test cases.
reason: Physics is encoded, but the absence of a reported diagnostic prevents score 3.

scenario: A posterior forecast is checked against held-out monitoring observations using coverage or posterior predictive diagnostics.
reason: The reliability of the uncertainty representation is evaluated.

scenario: An ensemble mean and standard deviation are plotted without coverage or reliability assessment.
coding_outcome: uncertainty_reported_not_calibrated; uncertainty score 1 or 2 depending on method
reason: Spread is reported, but calibration is not established.

scenario: A Bayesian inversion reports a posterior that reproduces assimilated data but provides no held-out or replicated-data check.
coding_outcome: uncertainty_reported_not_calibrated unless an explicit posterior predictive check is located
reason: Posterior existence and posterior reliability are different claims.

scenario: Training excludes one fault architecture and testing evaluates only that unseen architecture.
reason: The distribution shift and held-out axis are explicit.

scenario: Samples from one simulation ensemble are randomly divided into training and test sets.
coding_outcome: same_distribution_only; transferability score 0 if explicitly confirmed
reason: Random holdout tests interpolation, not transfer under a defined shift.

scenario: A model is tested on a simulated basin absent from training, but no field observations are used.
coding_outcome: unseen_geology_or_faults; transferability score 3; not cross-site field validation
reason: This is a simulated geological OOD test, not a field cross-site test.

scenario: An injection controller is evaluated against pressure and containment constraints, with an explicit objective and reviewable action rule.
coding_outcome: decision readiness score 3; score 4 only with demonstrated auditable operational use
reason: The output is connected to a tested decision mechanism.

scenario: A model predicts plume saturation accurately and the discussion states that it could assist operators.
coding_outcome: decision readiness score 1 unless a named decision linkage is demonstrated
reason: A storage-relevant prediction is not yet a tested decision workflow.

scenario: A pressure forecast is compared with a limit, but the paper does not define an action, uncertainty treatment, or review path.
coding_outcome: decision readiness score 2 or 3 pending full-text evidence of an evaluated threshold mechanism
reason: Mentioning a threshold is weaker than evaluating a decision rule around it.
